title: Dasakam 98 – Niṣkalabrahmopāsanam
description: Bhattathiri praises the incomprehensible Brahman as the ground of creation, perception, cosmic order and time, and ends by seeking refuge at Vishnu’s feet.

stanzas.sanskrit:
यस्मिन्नेतद्विभातं यत इदमभवद्येन चेदं य एत-
-द्योऽस्मादुत्तीर्णरूपः खलु सकलमिदं भासितं यस्य भासा ।
यो वाचां दूरदूरे पुनरपि मनसां यस्य देवा मुनीन्द्राः
नो विद्युस्तत्त्वरूपं किमु पुनरपरे कृष्ण तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९८-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri offered his salutations to Lord Guruvayoorappan, who is responsible for creation and protection of this universe, who is in the form of the universe, whose radiance gives brightness for this universe, whose description is beyond words and comprehension, whose true nature cannot be understood by even Devas and divine sages.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yasminnetadvibhātaṃ yata idamabhavadyena cedaṃ ya eta-
-dyo’smāduttīrṇarūpaḥ khalu sakalamidaṃ bhāsitaṃ yasya bhāsā |
yo vācāṃ dūradūre punarapi manasāṃ yasya devā munīndrāḥ
no vidyustattvarūpaṃ kimu punarapare kṛṣṇa tasmai namaste || 98-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जन्माथो कर्म नाम स्फुटमिह गुणदोषादिकं वा न यस्मिन्
लोकानामूतये यः स्वयमनुभजते तानि मायानुसारी ।
बिभ्रच्छक्तीररूपोऽपि च बहुतररूपोऽवभात्यद्भुतात्मा
तस्मै कैवल्यधाम्ने पररसपरिपूर्णाय विष्णो नमस्ते ॥ ९८-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri prostrated to that Brahman who is beyond the birth and death cycle, who is beyond good and bad deeds, who is above three Gunas,, accepted the Maaya, exhibited knowledge-ignorance, wealth and though formless took up various forms to protect the people of the world, while remaining in state of Supreme bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
janmātho karma nāma sphuṭamiha guṇadoṣādikaṃ vā na yasmin
lokānāmūtaye yaḥ svayamanubhajate tāni māyānusārī |
bibhracchaktīrarūpo’pi ca bahutararūpo’vabhātyadbhutātmā
tasmai kaivalyadhāmne pararasaparipūrṇāya viṣṇo namaste || 98-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नो तिर्यञ्चं न मर्त्यं न च सुरमसुरं न स्त्रियं नो पुमांसं
न द्रव्यं कर्मजातिं गुणमपि सदसद्वापि ते रूपमाहुः ।
शिष्टं यत्स्यान्निषेधे सति निगमशतैर्लक्षणावृत्तितस्तत्
कृच्छ्रेणावेद्यमानं परमसुखमयं भाति तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९८-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The Parabrahman form is neither a bird, nor an animal, human, deva, asura, female, male, not even five elements of nature, good or bad deeds, not three Gunas, living or non-living. If there is some thing left behind all these, then that form which even hundreds of vedas find it difficult to explain is the supreme Brahman.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
no tiryañcaṃ na martyaṃ na ca suramasuraṃ na striyaṃ no pumāṃsaṃ
na dravyaṃ karmajātiṃ guṇamapi sadasadvāpi te rūpamāhuḥ |
śiṣṭaṃ yatsyānniṣedhe sati nigamaśatairlakṣaṇāvṛttitastat
kṛcchreṇāvedyamānaṃ paramasukhamayaṃ bhāti tasmai namaste || 98-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मायायां बिम्बितस्त्वं सृजसि महदहङ्कारतन्मात्रभेदै-
-र्भूतग्रामेन्द्रियाद्यैरपि सकलजगत्स्वप्नसङ्कल्पकल्पम् ।
भूयः संहृत्य सर्वं कमठ इव पदान्यात्मना कालशक्त्या
गम्भीरे जायमाने तमसि वितिमिरो भासि तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९८-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri offered his salutations to the Brahman who reflects HIMSELF in HIS Maaya and created the whole universe using the Mahat, Ahankara, five senses Panchabhootas. During pralaya, the entire creation is destroyed and pulled back to the supreme Brahman form just like how the tortoise pulls its body inside its shell, causing an intense darkness everywhere, yet the supreme Brahman shines unaffected by the darkness.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
māyāyāṃ bimbitastvaṃ sṛjasi mahadahaṅkāratanmātrabhedai-
-rbhūtagrāmendriyādyairapi sakalajagatsvapnasaṅkalpakalpam |
bhūyaḥ saṃhṛtya sarvaṃ kamaṭha iva padānyātmanā kālaśaktyā
gambhīre jāyamāne tamasi vitimiro bhāsi tasmai namaste || 98-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
शब्दब्रह्मेति कर्मेत्यणुरिति भगवन् काल इत्यालपन्ति
त्वामेकं विश्वहेतुं सकलमयतया सर्वथा कल्प्यमानम् ।
वेदान्तैर्यत्तु गीतं पुरुषपरचिदात्माभिधं तत्तु तत्त्वं
प्रेक्षामात्रेण मूलप्रकृतिविकृतिकृत् कृष्ण तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९८-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri offered his salutations to Bhagwan Krishna, who is mentioned as primeval sound, actions, atom, time, whose supreme form is explained in Vedas as Purusha, Supreme consciousness, atma, who has the ability to create the maaya just from the corner of his eye.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śabdabrahmeti karmetyaṇuriti bhagavan kāla ityālapanti
tvāmekaṃ viśvahetuṃ sakalamayatayā sarvathā kalpyamānam |
vedāntairyattu gītaṃ puruṣaparacidātmābhidhaṃ tattu tattvaṃ
prekṣāmātreṇa mūlaprakṛtivikṛtikṛt kṛṣṇa tasmai namaste || 98-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सत्वेनासत्तया वा न च खलु सदसत्वेन निर्वाच्यरूपा
धत्ते यासावविद्या गुणफणिमतिवद्विश्वदृश्यावभासम् ।
विद्यात्वं सैव याता श्रुतिवचनलवैर्यत्कृपास्यन्दलाभे
संसारारण्यसद्यस्त्रुटनपरशुतामेति तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९८-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: It is difficult to explain Bhagwan’s swaroopam as to whether it exists or does not exists due to ignorance, just like it is difficult to differentiate between a rope and a snake in darkness. By singing the praises of Bhagwan and practising those mentioned in scriptures, one can gain the knowledge to cut the dark forest of Samsara.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
satvenāsattayā vā na ca khalu sadasatvena nirvācyarūpā
dhatte yāsāvavidyā guṇaphaṇimativadviśvadṛśyāvabhāsam |
vidyātvaṃ saiva yātā śrutivacanalavairyatkṛpāsyandalābhe
saṃsārāraṇyasadyastruṭanaparaśutāmeti tasmai namaste || 98-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूषासु स्वर्णवद्वा जगति घटशरावादिके मृत्तिकाव-
-त्तत्त्वे सञ्चिन्त्यमाने स्फुरति तदधुनाप्यद्वितीयं वपुस्ते ।
स्वप्नद्रष्टुः प्रबोधे तिमिरलयविधौ जीर्णरज्जोश्च यद्व-
-द्विद्यालाभे तथैव स्फुटमपि विकसेत् कृष्ण तस्मै नमस्ते ॥ ९८-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Just as jewels are made of gold, pots are made of mud & just as for a dreamer, on waking up, darkness vanishes, a worn out rope is seen clearly. Similarly one understands the divine form only after gaining the divine knowledge. Bhattathiri offered salutations to that form of Bhagwan
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūṣāsu svarṇavadvā jagati ghaṭaśarāvādike mṛttikāva-
-ttattve sañcintyamāne sphurati tadadhunāpyadvitīyaṃ vapuste |
svapnadraṣṭuḥ prabodhe timiralayavidhau jīrṇarajjośca yadva-
-dvidyālābhe tathaiva sphuṭamapi vikaset kṛṣṇa tasmai namaste || 98-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
यद्भीत्योदेति सूर्यो दहति च दहनो वाति वायुस्तथान्ये
यद्भीताः पद्मजाद्याः पुनरुचितबलीनाहरन्तेऽनुकालम् ।
येनैवारोपिताः प्राङ्निजपदमपि ते च्यावितारश्च पश्चात्
तस्मै विश्वं नियन्त्रे वयमपि भवते कृष्ण कुर्मः प्रणामम् ॥ ९८-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri prostrated to Bhagwan Krishna, from whom the sun, fire, wind, brahma, devas originated, learnt to do their work as purpose of the creation and loose their positions after the purpose is over and who created and control this entire universe.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yadbhītyodeti sūryo dahati ca dahano vāti vāyustathānye
yadbhītāḥ padmajādyāḥ punarucitabalīnāharante’nukālam |
yenaivāropitāḥ prāṅnijapadamapi te cyāvitāraśca paścāt
tasmai viśvaṃ niyantre vayamapi bhavate kṛṣṇa kurmaḥ praṇāmam || 98-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्रैलोक्यं भावयन्तं त्रिगुणमयमिदं त्र्यक्षरस्यैकवाच्यं
त्रीशानामैक्यरूपं त्रिभिरपि निगमैर्गीयमानस्वरूपम् ।
तिस्रोऽवस्था विदन्तं त्रियुगजनिजुषं त्रिक्रमाक्रान्तविश्वं
त्रैकाल्ये भेदहीनं त्रिभिरहमनिशं योगभेदैर्भजे त्वाम् ॥ ९८-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan Krishna through the creator of the 3 Gunas, one who is the meaning of the 3 letter word ''Pranava'', one who is the manifestation of  the Trinity, whose true nature is described by 3 vedas, who is the pure consciousness and exists in all the 3 states - awakening, sleeping, dreaming, one who has measured this entire universe in just HIS 3  strides, who remains unchanged in past, present and future times, who is worshipped by the means of 3 yogas - Gyaan, Bhakti and Karma.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
trailokyaṃ bhāvayantaṃ triguṇamayamidaṃ tryakṣarasyaikavācyaṃ
trīśānāmaikyarūpaṃ tribhirapi nigamairgīyamānasvarūpam |
tisro’vasthā vidantaṃ triyugajanijuṣaṃ trikramākrāntaviśvaṃ
traikālye bhedahīnaṃ tribhirahamaniśaṃ yogabhedairbhaje tvām || 98-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सत्यं शुद्धं विबुद्धं जयति तव वपुर्नित्यमुक्तं निरीहं
निर्द्वन्द्वं निर्विकारं निखिलगुणगणव्यञ्जनाधारभूतम् ।
निर्मूलं निर्मलं तन्निरवधिमहिमोल्लासि निर्लीनमन्त-
-र्निस्सङ्गानां मुनीनां निरुपमपरमानन्दसान्द्रप्रकाशम् ॥ ९८-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s form is eternal, pure, ever awake, devoid of bondages and actions, transcends all dualities, changeless, the originating point of forgiveness, truth, mercy, wealth and all good qualities, causeless, perfect and exhibiting limitless glory, exists in non-attachment hearts, shines with supreme consciousness.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
satyaṃ śuddhaṃ vibuddhaṃ jayati tava vapurnityamuktaṃ nirīhaṃ
nirdvandvaṃ nirvikāraṃ nikhilaguṇagaṇavyañjanādhārabhūtam |
nirmūlaṃ nirmalaṃ tanniravadhimahimollāsi nirlīnamanta-
-rnissaṅgānāṃ munīnāṃ nirupamaparamānandasāndraprakāśam || 98-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
दुर्वारं द्वादशारं त्रिशतपरिमिलत् षष्टिपर्वाभिवीतं
सम्भ्राम्यत् क्रूरवेगं क्षणमनु जगदाच्छिद्य सन्धावमानम् ।
चक्रं ते कालरूपं व्यथयतु न तु मां त्वत्पदैकावलम्बं
विष्णो कारुण्यसिन्धो पवनपुरपते पाहि सर्वामयौघात् ॥ ९८-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s wheel of time with its twelve spokes (months), and 360 teeth (days) is irreversible, going round with very high speed, capable of destroying the world in a minute. Having surrendered at the lotus feet of Bhagwan Krishna, Bhattathiri pleaded protection from the woes caused by the time wheel and from all afflictions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
durvāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ triśataparimilat ṣaṣṭiparvābhivītaṃ
sambhrāmyat krūravegaṃ kṣaṇamanu jagadācchidya sandhāvamānam |
cakraṃ te kālarūpaṃ vyathayatu na tu māṃ tvatpadaikāvalambaṃ
viṣṇo kāruṇyasindho pavanapurapate pāhi sarvāmayaughāt || 98-11 ||
